about_the_game:
A Casual Action-Adventure

IT'S ABOUT TIME

Play as 20 year old William Roger. It’s 2001 and your University professor has something special to show you!

The Cimera, a time traveling camera. That’s right, you accidentally activate it and get sucked through the time portal and land on a cliched beach, a long time ago, in a land far far away.

Adventure your way through time, discovering your independence, uncovering the secrets of the Time Earth Agency and the Evil Professors plans to dominate time and space. Will you find your way back home before you are history?

Lost, stolen, beaten, eaten and abducted by aliens (well, not that last part), adventure your way from the past to the future by adapting to your surroundings, escaping from the Cimera Universal Police agents, helping the local folk and of course, battling yourself, again and again and again.

THINGS SEEM A LITTLE ODD

Why does everything look a little off? Why are there pyramids in Rome? And why do I have so much sand in my shoe?

TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE

Up against the clock so to speak. The countdown on the Camera has started. Can you make the next jump before it's too late? No pressure though, you have 24 real world hours.

FIND YOUR INDEPENDENCE AND SO MUCH MORE!

After still living at home and having almost no independence, this little "accidental" trip of yours to the past is really going to test your limits. Gather more and more independence by levelling up your skills and discover your own self as well as finding love, friendship and loss as you venture forward through time.

OH NO! MY BOOK!

The pages from The Time Travelers Book of Questions (with no real answers), have been scattered around all of time and space. Probably a good idea to get those pages back together all in one place in order to find the true answers you need.

IT'S T.E.A. TIME

The Time Earth Agency wants to dominate and conquer time and space. Their C.U.P agents will hunt you down no matter what. Why does their leader look so familiar?

There is only one person that can save the universe (that would be you, of course).

Featuring:

  • Custom styled graphics.

  • Original music and mostly original sound.

  • Uncluttered, non-convoluted UI. (because who wants to sift through a spreadsheet of data)

  • Light Leveling System - Toughness. Independence. Muscle. Endurance.

  • Hybrid style cutscenes.

  • Many references to your favorite movies and games.

  • Oh, yes, and a cool purple backpack.


    Grab your fake leather backpack, navigate through time and space, get home, save the universe and accomplish so much more than you thought you could before time runs out in this, the first chapter of Time Jump.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Above settings could change
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Above settings could change

short_description: Using a time travelling camera called the Cimera, adventure your way through time, defending yourself against the Time Earth Agency, the Professor and everything else time and space throws at you. Can you save the Universe and can you find your way back home before you are history?
